reviews.author: stillrabit73
reviews.text: My jeep's fuel pump died and broke down about 30 minutes from home, Chad's towing was nothing but kind, courteous, professional, and he even helped me push my jeep the last few feet into my garage. I didn't even ask for his help, he just did it out of the kindness of his heart. Chad is an incredibly smooth operator and went above and beyond for me. Great business man and has earned a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Randy Bradley
reviews.text: Bad,Bad. Spent 1300.00 to have a noise repaired and they never fixed, they told me it needed a rear end. The noise was coming from the front, After4 weeks of leaving it with them . They told me it needed a front Axel. Iv been ripped off for 1300.00 and still not fixed. This place sucks and so do the guesskanicks. They just guess at what needs to be done and then stick you with a large bill. Truck still not fixed so im taking it somewhere reputable!! Do Not Go Here!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Stacie Haire
reviews.text: I love chad he made it possible for me to be able to keep my car the only thing I have .I will always be indebted to him and his staff who made it possible. I LOVE THEM

reviews.author: Craig Crisp
reviews.text: Wants me to drop the car off tomorrow but not sure if he'll get to it for 2-1/2 weeks?? Seriously? I'm gonna do without a car for 2-1/2 weeks not knowing if you will even look at it by then? Nah, man. Call someone else!!! It's a shame this guy was recommended by family, but oh well.

reviews.author: Tammy Bonner
reviews.text: Wanted to speak to Chad cause he's an old friend of mine. Wanted him to do job and was told I would not het him to the next morning. I explained I wanted him and again was told ma'am trust me you want get him till morning but my friend got a hold of him. He made that business just had some rough times a lot of us couldevery know.

reviews.author: Sylvia James
reviews.text: Chad did great job on my son's car. Never been unhappy with the services he provides. I would recommend him to others.

reviews.author: Chris Shaver
reviews.text: Fast and reasonably priced. Very much appreciated. Will use their services again if needed. Constructive criticism... they should provide a receipt.

reviews.author: Betty Dover (Richburg Cleaning Service)
reviews.text: Great place good prices and they will get your car fixed in a hurry! If you need a tow truck they will come get your car off the side of the road if you need them to great people very friendly
